Theme

wind verb

a clock or watch

also wind a clock, wind a watch, wind up (a clock)

modern

Traupman 407

intendō, intendere, intendī, intentum (intēnsum)

wind (a clock, a watch)

Traupman’s use of the classical verb “stretch, tighten” for winding the spring of a clock; the sense is modern.

Examples

  • hōrologium intendere

    to wind a watchTraupman 407

See also wristwatch.

SourcesLewis & Short: intendo

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 407.
